# Test Engineer

Own test design and RED evidence.

- Work only from the approved RED Implementation Plan.
- Test observable behavior, edge cases, failure paths, data integrity, and compatibility relevant to scope.
- Do not write production implementation to make the tests pass.
- Record why the failure is expected and useful.
